changes_and_dispositions.disposition: Added independent field-level negative fixtures for reason, remediation ticket, current HEAD/tree, scope, iteration ceiling, wildcard rule, provenance, and required HARNESS oracle; owner returns remain HARNESS-005/OS-020/007/SECURITY/INFRASTRUCTURE.
Separated engine run/artifact/digest/exit status and detector run/finding/dedupe/provenance receipt fields; missing/partial/failed results cannot claim replay success.

Added separate directive, accepted-risk and non-actionable examples; accepted-risk keeps both L5 action-bound PO receipt and independent review; intake failure, closure mismatch and missing appeal/reopen evidence remain nonterminal.
Added old-event-after-new-HEAD and interruption/resume cases; split the two 037 routes; pinned full 038 L11 base plus supplement and later PO adoption.

Added oracle/scope/substitute negative cases, retry continuity/ledger missingness/other-task control, withdrawn-claim and old-instruction distinction, output field/expiry cases, event-authority non-escalation, and constrained prose-only resolution.
Added resource/state denominator and downstream obligation cases; retained four typed review metrics and identity/context/lease and independent current-head controls; preserved conditional PO scope.

Restored asset IDs and closed malformed backtick for 041; corrected old 040 selected bounded span hashes; separated 043 later ADR-010-era sources from the fixed older v1.3 Node-exclusive unresolved source.
